deploy-bot: Deploy fanout starting to prod (change window 2026-03-20 23:00-01:00 UTC). Services: runtime@release/v1.12.3 (commit abcdef1), api@release/v1.12.3 (commit abcdef1), console@release/v1.12.3 (commit 9f8b7c2). Canary: 5% runtime/api, console parallel canary. tagging: release/v1.12.3. /deploy start
sophia: ack, tracking. I'll keep an eye on dashboards :eyes:
mike: watching logs for console canary
deploy-bot: Update: runtime -> HEALTHY (3/3 canary instances), api -> HEALTHY (no error spikes). console -> FAILING canary: 3x 500s from proxy -> backend on first canary pod. Rolling status: console: unhealthy
lee: console 500s look like upstream auth errors in nginx logs, getting stack traces now
carla: proposal: pin runtime & api to release/v1.12.3 to avoid cascading rollback while we handle console. partial rollback for console only if needed. +1 from me if ops agrees
mike: agree with partial rollback. can we trigger rollback just for console? what's the rollback command here?
sophia: @deploy-bot can you run console rollback to previous stable tag release/v1.12.2? I want to avoid touching runtime/api since they're green
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Initiating partial rollback: service=console target=release/v1.12.2 reason="canary 500s". Command: /deploy rollback service=console tag=release/v1.12.2
mike: running healthchecks locally against canary after rollback
deploy-bot: console rollback in progress -> pulling tag release/v1.12.2 (commit 1a2b3c4), draining failing canary pods, rolling update
deploy-bot: console rollback complete. Post-rollback health: console canary -> HEALTHY (200 OK x20), latency stable. No errors detected for 5m
carla: I've pinned runtime & api to v1.12.3 in routing policy (no automatic fallback). Leaving console at 1.12.2 for now until we get root cause
lee: I've captured nginx traces and opened an issue linking failing commit 9f8b7c2 -> suspected asset path change. Filed ticket: infra/console#452
sophia: good call on partial rollback. Mike, can you add a short blurb for release notes: "console: rollback to 1.12.2 after canary 500s; runtime/api stable at 1.12.3" and I'll follow up with postmortem if we see recurrence
mike: will do, adding to release notes and tagging the PR
deploy-bot: Summary: runtime=release/v1.12.3 (success), api=release/v1.12.3 (success), console=rolled back -> release/v1.12.2 (resolved). Incident link: <https://redwood/internal/incidents/452> :white_check_mark:
sophia: thanks everyone. closing this thread, will watch for related alerts overnight :thumbsup:
